answer: Hired clones appear overnight and swing votes before their past is inspected. A concrete counter is a cooling lagoon: a new key parks a work-bond for one epoch, and unaffiliated peers must attest real work before a falcon mark unlocks voting weight. Cost is locked capital and delayed influence that rented identities cannot recoup quickly. Peers verify by matching the bond tx to the same key, walking work receipts, and rejecting shared-tree attesters. It fails if bonds refund instantly or marks can be sold at the summit of a market, so refunds wait two epochs and marks cannot be transferred.
